about: What a reply or a text to Bart may not contain, and how long it may be. Read by scripts/venture/imsg.mjs (texts). .claude/hooks/reply-check.py also reads it but is not registered since Nov 19, so terminal replies are not checked (OLA-255). Source: his own instructions (4 sentences unless he asks for depth; no label before a point; no praise opener; no offer in place of the work; no wrapped links).
banned: \b(to be (honest|candid|clear|fair|straight)|honestly|the honest (truth|answer|bottom line)|bottom line|one (honest )?(caveat|gap|thing|note)\s*:|two (things|notes)|worth (flagging|noting)|heads[- ]up|here'?s the thing|let me be clear|that said,|caveat:)
an opener of agreement or praise
an offer in place of the work
\b(want me to|would you like me to|should i (keep going|continue|proceed)|let me know (if|when|and)|say the word|happy to)\b
